viewing_check: Armitage estimate 20-30, current bid $15 (rechecked on the lot page). Two tubs, roughly 100+ LPs, so at the $15 bid plus 22% premium the cost is about 18 AUD, well under 20c a record. The only titles identified (Will the Circle Be Unbroken triple, Red Apple Rag, Chubby at His Best) are individually worth about A$20 to 50 on eBay AU in the last 12 months, but common country/easy-listening LPs mostly sell in bulk lots at a few dollars each. Andy should flip through the tubs at viewing for rarer titles or Australian pressings. Prices are recent (2025 to 2026), broadly flat. Bulky (two tubs).
